content.text: {"quote_faithful": "yes", "verdict": "confirmed", "evidence_kind": "missing_justification", "fatal": "yes", "explanation": "The quote is verbatim and is the entire inductive step of the text's proof of Lemma (ii), on which Liu's lower bound (\u00a73) rests. As written the step is unsupported. (a) A split replaces a column of height u+v by heights u and v at an arbitrary position, so cut levels need not be multiples of d; the text never says how the 'mental strips of height d' survive such a cut, nor what 'a whole d-strip remains uncancelled in the odd row' means once columns are non-multiples of d. (b) The arithmetic is incoherent: the new column has 2^{j+1} strips, whereas the preceding columns d,2d,...,2^j d comprise 2^{j+1}-1 strips, so 'two identical copies of all preceding strips' would be 2^{j+2}-2 strips, not 2^{j+1}. (c) Splits may be applied to already-split pieces, so 'a cut has occurred in every one of these j+1 columns' is not shown to force s+1 cuts. No other passage supplies the argument."}
